text:
marta: kickstarting a staged rollout for routing-service v4.0.0. plan: dark launch internal -> 10% eu-west-1 -> 25% global. change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. need stop/go from release ops for regional gating.

deploy-bot: [automated] Rollout initiated: routing-service@v4.0.0 -> dark launch (internal only). rollout_id=rl-20260410-02. Pin=sha256:aa12bc... To pause: `deployctl pause rl-20260410-02` / rollback: `deployctl rollback rl-20260410-02`.

devin: noted. which cohorts are in internal sample? shadowing traffic + 2% internal beta users.

marta: internal sample = traffic.header.x-internal==true OR cohort=beta. dark routes applied.

leo: SLIs for ramp: 4xx/5xx, p95, avg latency, embedding-similarity drift for routed models. baseline for p95=180ms. rollback if p95 > 400ms for 4m OR 5xx > 1% sustained 3m.

sam: adding a runbook note: infra-pager oncall will escalate at 2% 5xx. I'll paste ack channel.

infra-pager: acknowledged. we'll watch logs and open infra incident if noisy.

deploy-bot: [automated] Dark launch metrics @ +8m: internal requests=8.1k/min, 5xx=0.05%, p95=95ms. No anomalies. Ready to start 10% eu-west-1 at 23:10 UTC on thumbs.

marta: quick check: eu-west-1 get only new quantized fp16 kernel. confirm kconfig?

devin: yes, variant=fp16-optimized, kernel_override=libattn_v2. Also enabling kv-cache partitioning for EU.

leo: I'll pre-seat queries to embed set A and run similarity check. posting small eval link in a sec.

leo: eval results (5m in): similarity-drop=0.6% (within tolerance), but noticed small tokenization discrepancy on chat-turns with non-ascii.

marta: hmm — any errors in payload handling?

devin: logs show a sanitized header rewrite in eu proxy (old behavior) that causes tokenizer to see CRLF. patch is trivial but needs a hotfix.

sam: hotfix path options: 1) rollback EU to v3.9.9 (pin), 2) patch proxy & continue ramp, 3) pause eu expansion and run more tests. which do we want?

infra-pager: if we keep EU at 10% and issue remains, it could cause regressions for customers. recommend pin EU to v3.9.9 until proxy fix deployed.

marta: I'm leaning pin EU only and continue global ramp outside eu-west-1. want to avoid customer impact. quick vote: :thumbsup: pin EU to v3.9.9, :thumbsdown: pause entire rollout. 20s.

leo: :thumbsup: pin EU.

devin: :thumbsup: pin EU; i'll start proxy patch PR but won't merge until after cutover.

sam: :thumbsup: pin EU.

deploy-bot: [automated] Action: applying regional pin for rollout rl-20260410-02 -> eu-west-1 pinned to routing-service@v3.9.9. Command executed: `deployctl pin-region rl-20260410-02 eu-west-1 routing-service@v3.9.9`.

marta: thanks. updating release notes: "v4.0.0 staged: EU pinned to v3.9.9 due to tokenizer proxy mismatch; rest of rollout proceeding." will include manifest and RFC link.

devin: starting gradual ramp outside EU: scaling to 25% for non-eu regions at 23:25 UTC.

deploy-bot: [automated] Rollout update: non-eu regions scaled to 25% at 23:25 UTC. rollout_id=rl-20260410-02. Next checkpoint in 15m.

leo: ongoing metrics: non-eu p95=160ms, 5xx=0.08%, embed-sim drift 0.4%. looks ok.

infra-pager: received a page for a customer in eu-west experiencing tokenization errors (one report). we are tracing request id=req-7f9a.

marta: thanks infra. we'll keep EU pinned until devin's proxy fix is validated and smoke-tested. devin, please coordinate a hotfix rollout in eu-alone window.

devin: will do. plan: patch -> canary in eu-proxy -> small eu test, target window 02:30-03:00 UTC. I'll post a new thread for that patch.

sam: final note: manifest stored at s3://releases/rl-20260410-02/manifest.json. release notes updated and changelog entry created.

deploy-bot: [automated] Checkpoint @23:40 UTC: non-eu stable @25%. eu-west-1 pinned to v3.9.9. metrics summary: non-eu 5xx=0.09%, p95=165ms. no rollback triggered.

marta: holding thread until end of change window. signal = go for non-eu; EU=hold/pinned. Closing thread after window."
